name: Ascadian Isles
description: A fertile agricultural region of islands and peninsulas in southernmost Vvardenfell, its plantations and pilgrim paths watered by lakes Amaya and Hairan.
lore: The breadbasket of the island, worked by Hlaalu plantations and dotted with kwama egg mines. The pilgrim road of the Seven Graces crosses it from Vivec to Balmora, and the Fields of Kummu lie along the way.

name: Ashlands
description: A forsaken ash desert of dunes and lava rock surrounding Red Mountain, the bleak homeland of the northern Ashlander tribes.
lore: Rain never falls here; blight storms blow down from Red Mountain and the dead of Kogoruhn walk. Ald'ruhn sits at its western edge and the Urshilaku camp on its northern shore.

name: Azura's Coast
description: A mostly uninhabited region of rocky islands and peninsulas along Vvardenfell's eastern shore, the demesne of House Telvanni.
lore: Fungal towers rise from the shallows and the coast shelters the outcast and the outlaw alike. The Shrine of Azura and the monastery of Holamayan are hidden among its islands.

name: Bitter Coast
description: A swampy and poor region along Vvardenfell's western coast, its salt marshes and fog-bound inlets hiding smugglers and shipwrecks.
lore: The wet, warm corner of the island where the Odai River meets the Inner Sea. Seyda Neen, Gnaar Mok and Hla Oad cling to its shore, and its waters conceal the wreck of the same-named ship.

name: Grazelands
description: The open pasturelands of northeastern Vvardenfell, where Ashlander herds and Telvanni wizard-towers share the country.
lore: Green and defensible, and thus contested: the Ahemmusa, Zainab and other Ashlander clans graze here beside the towers of Tel Vos and Tel Mora.

name: Molag Amur
description: A harsh region of volcanic rock and lava pools in the southeastern interior of Vvardenfell, crossed by foyadas and crowned by Mount Kand.
lore: The least hospitable land on the island save Red Mountain itself. Molag Mar guards its coast and the Erabenimsun Ashlanders and the ruins of Dagoth Ur's servants lie within.

name: Red Mountain
description: The great volcano at the heart of Vvardenfell, ringed by the Ghostfence and crowned by the citadel of Dagoth Ur. Within its Heart Chamber beats the Heart of Lorkhan.
lore: Called Dagoth-Ur in elder days; the site of the Battle of Red Mountain and the source of the Blight. The Tribunal raised the Ghostfence to contain what sleeps beneath.

name: Sheogorad
description: A wild region of islands and peninsulas surrounding Sheogorad Island off Vvardenfell's northern coast, named for the Mad God.
lore: Settled only by fisherfolk, outcasts and holy hermits — among them those who tend the Sanctus Shrine. Dagon Fel is the chief harbour of the north.

name: West Gash
description: A rocky highland region in western Vvardenfell, rich in minerals and kwama mines, holding Balmora, Caldera and Gnisis.
lore: Cut by the Odai and Samsi rivers and crossed by the road that binds the Hlaalu capital, the Imperial ebony town of Caldera and the Redoran frontier at Gnisis.

name: Vivec City
description: The holy city built upon the water, carved from a lie. Cantons of stone rise over the Inner Sea around the Palace of Vivec.
lore: The largest city in Vvardenfell and the seat of the living god Vivec, each canton a tiered fortress of plazas and underworks connected by bridges and gondolas. Beneath it lies the Ministry of Truth, a floating rock held in place by Vivec's will.

name: Arena
description: One of Vivec's cantons, given over to the Arena where duels to the death are fought between honorable competitors.

name: Foreign Quarter
description: The canton of Vivec that houses non-Dunmer citizens, their shops, and the local halls of the Imperial Guilds.

name: Hlaalu Compound
description: The canton of Vivec occupied by Great House Hlaalu and its retainers.

name: Redoran Compound
description: The canton of Vivec occupied by Great House Redoran and its retainers.

name: St. Delyn Canton
description: A canton of Vivec owned by the Dunmer Temple, offering low-cost housing to deserving members of the faith.

name: St. Olms Canton
description: A canton of Vivec offering low-cost housing and shop space to deserving merchants.

name: Telvanni Compound
description: The canton of Vivec occupied by Great House Telvanni and its retainers.

name: Temple Compound
description: Also known as the High Fane, the largest Dunmer temple in Vvardenfell and the seat of the Tribunal Temple in Vivec.

name: Ministry of Truth
description: A gigantic floating rock above Vivec, riddled with tunnels and serving as a base and "re-education center" for the secretive Ordinators.
lore: Suspended over the city by the god Vivec's power alone; if his will ever failed the Ministry would fall and crush the cantons beneath it.

name: Palace of Vivec
description: The canton at the heart of Vivec, home of the living god and site of the Puzzle Canal that tests the pilgrim.

name: Ald'ruhn
description: The seat of House Redoran, built in the shadow of Sk'ar — the monumental shell of a dead emperor crab.
lore: Beneath the crab-shell of Sk'ar lies the Manor District, the fortified heart of Redoran power on Vvardenfell. Beyond the walls the Ashlands begin.

name: Balmora
description: The seat of House Hlaalu and the de-facto trading capital of Vvardenfell, terraced along the Odai River beneath the Tower of the Eastern Wind.
lore: A dusty, bustling town of stone stairways on the Odai. The Blades' spymaster Caius Cosades keeps rooms here among the Hlaalu, and it is the young outlander's first true city.

name: Caldera
description: A mining town carved into a caldera, ruled by the Aldred family of House Hlaalu and home to a large Orcish population working the ebony mine.

name: Ebonheart
description: The Imperial castle town west of Vivec on the Inner Sea, seat of the Emperor's authority and of the Imperial Cult on Vvardenfell.
lore: A grey Imperial town of keeps and garrison walls facing Vivec across the water — the visible edge of the Empire's uneasy hold on Morrowind.

name: Molag Mar
description: A fortified Tribunal Temple town and pilgrimage destination on the shores of a bay in the Molag Amur region.

name: Sadrith Mora
description: The isle seat of the Telvanni Council, its towers grown from fungus, with the Imperial outpost of Wolverine Hall nearby.
lore: A town of living mushroom towers on a sheltered bay, ruled by the agreement of rival Telvanni mages rather than any law. Outsiders may enter the Council House only as retainers.

name: Ald Velothi
description: A small Redoran harbor village on the northern coast, north of Gnisis.

name: Dagon Fel
description: A small Imperial fishing village in the far north of Sheogorad, populated almost entirely by Nords.

name: Ghostgate
description: A Tribunal Temple fortress set into the Ghostfence, the only lawful gateway through the wall into the Red Mountain wastes.

name: Gnaar Mok
description: A small Hlaalu fishing village on the Bitter Coast, its stilted shacks half-swallowed by the swamp.

name: Gnisis
description: A Redoran egg-mining village on the West Gash with a notable bazaar, an Imperial fort, and a cranky Telvanni wizard.

name: Hla Oad
description: A small Hlaalu fishing village and smuggler's stop-off on the Bitter Coast, at the mouth of the Odai.

name: Khuul
description: A grim fishing village on the northwestern shore, last resting point before the Ashlands and the haunted ruins of Kogoruhn.

name: Maar Gan
description: A Redoran temple village on the edge of the Ashlands and a site of Tribunal pilgrimage.

name: Pelagiad
description: An Imperial farming village and retirement community northwest of Vivec, guarded by a Legion fort.

name: Seyda Neen
description: A small Imperial harbor village and census outpost on the far southwestern edge of Vvardenfell, where the outlander's journey begins.
lore: The port where the prisoner released from the Imperial dungeons first sets foot on Vvardenfell, and where the business of the Census and Excise Office begins.

name: Suran
description: A Hlaalu trading village northeast of Vivec, known for its House of Earthly Delights.

name: Tel Aruhn
description: The Telvanni tower-town of Archmagister Gothren, grown from fungus on an island off the coast.

name: Tel Branora
description: The Telvanni tower of Mistress Therana, on a small island off Azura's Coast.

name: Tel Fyr
description: The fungal tower of Divayth Fyr on the eastern coast, containing the Corprusarium where the corprus-stricken are kept.
lore: The demesne of the ancient sorcerer Divayth Fyr, who alone among his peers tends the incurable. Yagrum Bagarn, last living Dwemer, dwells below.

name: Tel Mora
description: The Telvanni tower of Mistress Dratha, standing on an island in the Sea of Ghosts.

name: Tel Vos
description: A Telvanni tower built over the Velothi village of Vos, the home of Master Aryon.

name: Vos
description: A small Velothi farming village on the eastern coast of Vvardenfell, beneath the shadow of Tel Vos.

name: Buckmoth Legion Fort
description: An Imperial Legion fort near Ald'ruhn, standing watch over the road into the Ashlands.

name: Fort Darius
description: A gatehouse-fort guarding the eastern entrance to Gnisis.

name: Fort Firemoth
description: An abandoned Imperial Legion fort on a circular formation of islands in the Inner Sea west of Seyda Neen, retaken in the official Firemoth plugin.

name: Fort Pelagiad
description: An Imperial Legion fort in Pelagiad, guarding the road between Vivec and Balmora.

name: Hawkmoth Legion Garrison
description: The headquarters of the Imperial Legion on Vvardenfell, within the castle town of Ebonheart.

name: Moonmoth Legion Fort
description: An Imperial Legion fort near Balmora, on the road west toward Caldera.

name: Wolverine Hall
description: An Imperial Legion fort near Sadrith Mora, housing the local branches of the Imperial Guilds.

name: Indarys Manor
description: A Redoran stronghold raised on the site of Bal Isra in the western Ashlands, the reward of a rising House kinsman.

name: Rethan Manor
description: A Hlaalu stronghold on the Odai Plateau southwest of Balmora.

name: Tel Uvirith
description: A Telvanni stronghold in the Molag Amur region, raised on the site of Uvirith's Grave.

name: Ahemmusa Camp
description: The home camp of the Ahemmusa Ashlander clan, in the northern Grazelands.

name: Erabenimsun Camp
description: The home camp of the Erabenimsun Ashlander clan, in the Molag Amur region.

name: Urshilaku Camp
description: The home camp of the Urshilaku Ashlander clan, on the northern Ashlands coast; keepers of the Nerevarine prophecies.

name: Zainab Camp
description: The home camp of the Zainab Ashlander clan, in the Grazelands.

name: Aharasaplit Camp
description: An Ashlander camp on the southern shore of Sheogorad, southwest of Dagon Fel and north of the mainland.

name: Aidanat Camp
description: A small Ashlander camp just south of Ald Velothi.

name: Ashamanu Camp
description: An outcast Ashlander camp on an island west of Tel Aruhn.

name: Bensiberib Camp
description: A small Ashlander camp on the mainland of Azura's Coast, between Tel Fyr and Tel Uvirith.

name: Elanius Camp
description: A small Ashlander camp in the Grazelands, not far northeast of the Dunmer stronghold Falensarano.

name: Kaushtababi Camp
description: A small Ashlander camp south of Molag Mar, just over the mountains.

name: Mamshar-Disamus Camp
description: An isolated Ashlander camp just east of the ruins of Kogoruhn.

name: Massahanud Camp
description: The home of a small group of Ashlanders southwest of the Dunmer stronghold Indoranyon.

name: Mila-Nipal
description: A simple yurt northeast of the Daedric shrine Dushariran and east of Salothan Ancestral Tomb.

name: Salit Camp
description: A medium-sized outcast Ashlander settlement southwest of Tel Mora.

name: Shashmanu Camp
description: A desolate camp east of Ald Velothi and south of Khuul.

name: Shashurari Camp
description: A tiny outcast Ashlander settlement west of Erabenimsun Camp.

name: Sobitbael Camp
description: A yurt on Azura's Coast, north of Erabenimsun Camp.

name: Yakaridan Camp
description: A yurt south of Tel Vos.

name: Bal Isra
description: A barren site in the western Ashlands between Ald'ruhn and Maar Gan, chosen by House Redoran for the stronghold of Indarys Manor.

name: Fields of Kummu
description: A holy ground of the Tribunal Temple on the east-west path from Balmora to Suran, where the pilgrim must show humility.

name: Ghostfence
description: The enormous shield-like wall of magicka and bone raised by the Tribunal to contain the blight of Red Mountain.
lore: A barrier of enchanted pillars and stakes encircling the volcano, patrolled and maintained by the Temple at the fortress of Ghostgate.

name: Holamayan
description: A monastery on an isolated island north of the Shrine of Azura on Azura's Coast, reachable only by secret means.
lore: A haven of the Dissident Priests, hidden from the Tribunal's Ordinators, where the true history of the Nerevarine is preserved.

name: Khartag Point
description: A rocky headland northwest of Gnaar Mok and east of the Neglected Shipwreck.

name: Manor District
description: The district of Ald'ruhn holding the manors and council hall of House Redoran — the seat of Redoran power on Vvardenfell.

name: Mount Assarnibibi
description: A mountain peak north of Molag Mar, the destination of a high-ranking Tribunal Temple pilgrimage.

name: Mount Kand
description: A mountain northwest of Molag Mar, crowned by a shrine and riddled with caverns.

name: Odai Plateau
description: The plateau southwest of Balmora where House Hlaalu raises the stronghold of Rethan Manor.

name: Sanctus Shrine
description: A shrine sacred to the Tribunal Temple on an island in the Sheogorad region, due west of Dagon Fel.

name: Uvirith's Grave
description: An isolated place in the Molag Amur region that House Telvanni claims for the stronghold of Tel Uvirith.

name: Foyada Ashur-Dan
description: The hardened lava river that runs from the crater of Red Mountain into the Molag Amur region.

name: Foyada Bani-Dad
description: The hardened lava river that starts at Red Mountain and runs just north of Maar Gan to the coast north of Khuul.

name: Foyada Esannudan
description: The short hardened lava river between Foyada Mamaea and Foyada Ashur-Dan.

name: Foyada Ilibaal
description: The foyada leading from Molag Mar to Mount Kand, through the rugged country of Molag Amur.

name: Foyada Mamaea
description: The hardened lava river that runs from Ghostgate past Balmora all the way to Hla Oad.

name: Foyada Nadanat
description: The foyada that runs through the Molag Amur region to Erabenimsun Camp.

name: Foyada Zabirbael
description: The foyada that runs northeast from Mount Kand to Mount Assarnibibi, linking two pilgrim sites.

name: Valley of the Wind
description: A fabled valley in the northeastern Ashlands.

name: Inner Sea
description: The ocean surrounding the southern and western parts of Vvardenfell, dividing the island from mainland Morrowind.

name: Lake Amaya
description: A large lake in the Ascadian Isles region of Vvardenfell.

name: Lake Hairan
description: A small lake between Pelagiad and Vivec.

name: Lake Masobi
description: A small lake to the west of Suran.

name: Lake Nabia
description: A small lake in the Molag Amur region, north of Suran.

name: Nabia River
description: A river in the Molag Amur region of Vvardenfell.

name: Odai River
description: The river that flows through Balmora, carrying trade from the West Gash down to the Bitter Coast.

name: River Samsi
description: A large waterway in the West Gash region of Vvardenfell.

name: Sea of Ghosts
description: The ocean surrounding the top half of Vvardenfell and all of northeastern Tamriel.

name: Zafirbel Bay
description: A large body of water on Azura's Coast, sheltered by the islands around Sadrith Mora.
